column1: # Stage S10 H1a, third of four: the frontend's wire types (`foundation/transport/dto`) and their
# typed identifiers become crates/frontend/foundation/frontend_api_dtos. The folder becomes the
# crate's `src`, its module tree `lib.rs`. The prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to the moved folder
# and one `frontend_api_dtos::` row scoped to the app's source. The DTOs' re-exports of the mission
# and ballistics crates went before the move: consumers import those crates directly.
